claims.text: Indicated in TB with closed-space infections such as meningitis, when inflammation is a major cause of morbidity
claims.quote: Glucocorticoids are sometimes used as part of TB management when inflammation is a major cause of morbidity and are indicated for patients with acute respiratory failure (31) or with closed-space infections, such as meningitis (32)

claims.text: Dexamethasone 12 mg PO or IV every 6 h for patients >25 kg; children <25 kg get 8 mg; continued for 2 to 3 weeks
claims.quote: Dexamethasone 12 mg orally or IV every 6 hours is given to patients > 25 kg; children < 25 kg are given 8 mg. Treatment is continued for 2 to 3 weeks.
